question: Please calculate the race completion percentage of Japanese drivers from 2007 to 2009.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "japanese_results_2007_2009" AS SELECT r2.year AS year, r3.raceid AS raceid, r3.driverid AS driverid, d.forename AS driver_forename, d.surname AS driver_surname, d.nationality AS driver_nationality, s.status AS status FROM table_3 AS r3 JOIN table_1 AS d ON r3.driverid = d.driverid JOIN table_2 AS r2 ON r3.raceid = r2.raceid LEFT JOIN table_13 AS s ON r3.statusid = s.statusid WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese' AND r2.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT year, raceid, driverid, status
  FROM japanese_results_2007_2009
),
flags AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    CASE 
      WHEN LOWER(status) IN ('did not qualify','did not prequalify','excluded','withdrawn','did not participate','did not start') THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END AS is_start,
    CASE 
      WHEN LOWER(status) = 'finished' OR LOWER(status) LIKE '+% lap%'
        THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_finish
  FROM base
),
year_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(year AS VARCHAR) AS period,
    SUM(is_start) AS starts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_start=1 AND is_finish=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finishes,
    CASE WHEN SUM(is_start) > 0 
      THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_start=1 AND is_finish=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(is_start), 2)
      ELSE NULL 
    END AS completion_pct
  FROM flags
  GROUP BY year
),
overall AS (
  SELECT 
    'All (2007-2009)' AS period,
    SUM(is_start) AS starts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_start=1 AND is_finish=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finishes,
    CASE WHEN SUM(is_start) > 0 
      THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_start=1 AND is_finish=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(is_start), 2)
      ELSE NULL 
    END AS completion_pct
  FROM flags
)
SELECT * FROM year_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM overall
ORDER BY period;

from typing import Any

# Overall completion percentage for Japanese drivers across 2007-2009
# Finish = 'Finished' or '+N Lap(s)'; starts exclude DNQ/DNPQ/DNS/etc.
sql = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT year, status
  FROM japanese_results_2007_2009
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
),
flags AS (
  SELECT
    CASE 
      WHEN LOWER(status) IN ('did not qualify','did not prequalify','excluded','withdrawn','did not participate','did not start') THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END AS is_start,
    CASE 
      WHEN LOWER(status) = 'finished' OR LOWER(status) LIKE '+% lap%'
        THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_finish
  FROM base
)
SELECT 
  '2007-2009' AS period,
  SUM(is_start) AS starts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_start=1 AND is_finish=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finishes,
  CASE WHEN SUM(is_start) > 0 
    THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_start=1 AND is_finish=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(is_start), 2)
    ELSE NULL 
  END AS completion_pct
FROM flags;
